game_concept: A survival strategy set in Snowy Hold – Sled Run, a steep sled run: the innkeeper must handle ice wolves while practicing functions. Core idea – Countdown Recursion: Use a simple self-calling function to count down to a base case.
theme: Snowy Hold – Sled Run: a steep sled run
core_gameplay_loop: In Sled Run, repeat each round: Use a simple self-calling function to count down to a base case. Each round, ice wolves strike the ice mill, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the base_case value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the ice mill from ice wolves in Sled Run: keep the base_case meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 41-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: base_case drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 41-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 8 (extended tier): Countdown Recursion
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how base_case changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ice wolves in Sled Run.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 41 seconds while base_case > 0.
